# Caruso Martech

> Caruso Martech is a marketing consultancy that builds marketing systems and growth strategy for founder-led and scale-up businesses. We work across strategy, paid media, marketing automation, and analytics for SaaS, events, ecommerce, and professional services companies, with budgets typically in the €5,000-€30,000 range.

Key areas of work: performance marketing (Meta, Google, LinkedIn), marketing automation and CRM workflow design, SEO, attribution and measurement, and fractional CMO engagements. We favor practical, evidenced writing over generic marketing advice, with real campaign numbers and case studies wherever possible.

## Pages

- [Home](https://carusomartech.com/): Overview of Caruso Martech and what we do. Marketing systems and growth strategy for SaaS, events, ecommerce, and professional services.
- [Work](https://carusomartech.com/work): Case studies from paid media campaigns across events, B2B, coaching, and recreation verticals, with measurable ROAS and lead generation results.
- [Services](https://carusomartech.com/services): Services covering growth strategy, paid media, SEO, marketing automation, and analytics. Retainer and project engagements available.
- [About](https://carusomartech.com/about): The thinking behind Caruso Martech and the approach to fixing broken marketing systems across industries.
- [Insights](https://carusomartech.com/insights): Practical articles on marketing leadership, system design, attribution, and automation.
- [Contact](https://carusomartech.com/contact): How to get in touch to discuss a marketing challenge or book a call.

## Insights Articles

- [How Much Should a Small Business Actually Spend on Marketing?](https://carusomartech.com/insights/marketing-budget-percentage-of-revenue): Percentage-of-revenue benchmarks are only a starting point. Here is what the real data shows, and how to build a marketing budget around acquisition cost instead of a guess.
- [How AI Search Engines Decide Which Sites to Cite](https://carusomartech.com/insights/how-ai-search-engines-decide-which-sites-to-cite): ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews cite some brands constantly and others never. Here is what the data says actually earns a citation, and how a small marketing team can act on it.
- [How to Brief AI for Marketing Copy Without Losing Your Brand Voice](https://carusomartech.com/insights/briefing-ai-for-marketing-copy): Generic prompts produce generic copy. A practical framework for briefing AI so it drafts marketing copy that actually sounds like your brand.
- [Attribution Reporting Gaps After a Platform Migration: A Diagnostic Checklist](https://carusomartech.com/insights/attribution-gaps-after-platform-migration): A GA4 update, ad platform change, or CRM migration can break attribution reporting overnight. Here is a practical checklist for finding the gap and fixing it before the next budget review.
- [Marketing Manager or Fractional CMO: Which Should You Hire First?](https://carusomartech.com/insights/marketing-manager-vs-fractional-cmo): A marketing manager and a fractional CMO solve two different problems. Here is how to tell which one your business actually needs, and what it costs to get the order wrong.
- [AI Agents in Marketing: What They Can Actually Do for a Small Team Right Now](https://carusomartech.com/insights/ai-agents-marketing-small-teams): AI agents are being pitched as autonomous marketing hires. Here is what they genuinely handle well for a small team in 2026, and where a human still needs to be in the loop.
- [The Marketing KPIs That Actually Matter (And How to Track Them Without New Software)](https://carusomartech.com/insights/marketing-kpis-that-actually-matter): Most marketing dashboards are full of vanity metrics. Here is which KPIs actually predict revenue for a small marketing team, and how to build a simple dashboard around them.
- [The Questions to Ask Before You Automate Your Marketing](https://carusomartech.com/insights/marketing-automation-readiness-checklist): Most marketing automation builds stall for reasons that have nothing to do with the software. A practical readiness checklist for small business teams before they buy or build anything.
- [How to Audit Your Martech Stack in a Day](https://carusomartech.com/insights/martech-stack-audit): A practical one-day framework for auditing your martech stack: what tools exist, what's connected, what's actually used, and what to cut.
- [The AI Search Attribution Gap: Measuring Marketing When ChatGPT and Google Hide the Journey](https://carusomartech.com/insights/ai-search-attribution-gap): AI Overviews and chatbots are removing clicks from the buyer journey. Here is how to build a measurement model that accounts for what your attribution software can no longer see.
- [Automating Marketing Workflows: A Practical Guide](https://carusomartech.com/insights/automating-marketing-workflows): How modern marketing teams automate reporting, attribution, and campaign operations using AI and workflow systems.
- [What a Modern Marketing System Actually Looks Like in 2026](https://carusomartech.com/insights/modern-marketing-system-2025): A practical model for building a modern marketing system across tools, process ownership, and measurement so teams can scale with less operational waste.
- [Attribution in 2026: From Last-Click Myths to Decision-Grade Measurement](https://carusomartech.com/insights/attribution-challenges-2025): Why last-click attribution fails in modern marketing and what a practical, decision-grade attribution model looks like across GA4, CRM, and budget planning.
